# Insects: All 100% chance spawn locations including map

![Insects: All 100% chance spawn locations including map](/uploads/671_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Many challenges in Fallout 76 require you to find and kill insects. There are places for this all over Appalachia, Skyline Valley and Burning Springs. But you can also find insects in instances. And of course there are various events and activities where you can find insects.

## What counts as insects?

- Bloat flies
- Blood beetle
- Fireflies
- Cave crickets
- Honey Beasts
- Swarm of bees
- The Mothman
- Mistcrawler
- RAD ants
- RAD cockroach
- RAD Scorpio
- Stingwings
- Ticks

## Locations with 100% insect spawns

-Burning Springs
 - Athens: bloat flies, RAD scorpions
 - Super Duper Mart: bloat flies, RAD scorpions
 - Hocking Hills Station: RAD Cockroaches, Bloatflies & Burning RAD Scorpions
 - Corn world: bloat flies, RAD scorpions
 - Northeast of Abraxodyne Chemical Substation 4 corrosive Stingwings
- Forest
 - Flatwoods: RAD cockroaches
 - Tyler County: RAD Cockroaches
 - Aaronhold Manor: RAD cockroaches, swarm of bees, 9 random insect spawns
 - On the New River Gorge Bridge: Blood Beetle
 - New River Gorge Resort: Bloatflies
 - Moonshine Shack: Ticks
 - Landblick Lighthouse: RAD Cockroaches & Fireflies
 - Gorge junkyard: fireflies, RAD cockroaches, ticks
- Toxic Valley
 - Hemlock Holes: RAD cockroaches
 - Clarksburg: RAD Cockroaches
 - Smith Farm: RAD Scorpions
-Ash Heap
 - Beckley: RAD cockroaches
 - Charleston Landfill: RAD cockroaches
 - Strikers Row: RAD cockroaches
 - Monongah Substation MZ-03 (at Big Bend Tunnel West): RAD ants
- Savage Divide
 - Knives Edge: RAD Scorpions
 - Prickett`s Fort: RAD cockroaches
 - Sunnytop slopes: RAD cockroaches
 - South of Sunnytop Station & Slopes: Ticks
 - Southeast of Monongah Power Plant: Ticks & RAD Roaches
 - Spruce Knob Campground: Random Insects & Ticks
 - Freakshow: Flatulent Flies & Honey Beasts
 - Bleeding Kate`s Grindhouse: Stingwings
 - Bastion Park: Random insects
 - Whitespring Golf Club: RAD cockroaches
 - Midmountain Huts: Honey Beasts
 - South of Whitespring Golf Club (between "83A" and the snake on the map): Stingwings
 - Federal disposal center HZ-21: RAD cockroaches & ticks (southeast/southwest)
 - Dent & Sons Contruction: Stingwings
- Moor
 - North of the Eye of the Moor: bloat flies
 - Northeast between Freddy Fear's House of Horrors and Eye of the Moor: Bloatflies and Honeybeasts
 - Hunter's Hut: Ticks
 - Southampton Estate: Blood Beetle
 - West of Big B`s Rest Stop: Ticks
 - Southeast of Big B`s Rest Stop: Stingwings
 - Tanagra Town: Cave BBQ
 - Looted Bunker: Blood Beetle
 - Thunder Mountain Substation TM-01: Random insects
 - South of Sanctuary & Haven Church: Blood Beetles & RAD Cockroaches
 - Crevasse Dam: RAD cockroaches & blood beetles
 - Dolly Sods: RAD Cockroaches & Ticks
-Cranberry Bog
 - Flooded depot: RAD cockroaches
 - Leave Bog-Town: RAD Cockroaches
 - RobCo Research Center: RAD cockroaches
 - Dropping point G3: ticks
 - Northeast of drop point V9: ticks
- Skyline Valley
 - Northwest of the Saxony Research Center: bloat flies
 - Northwest of the Old Crimora Mine: Cave Grilling
 - Old Rag Lookout: Blood Beetle
 - East of Old Rag lookout: RAD A
